verdict.rationale: ReadMe's docs describe a built-in Agent. It is called "a powerful documentation assistant" that creates, edits and enhances content across Guides, API References and Custom Pages, using an AI chat panel for drafting and research. Inline AI also applies plain-language edits to selected text, and the GitHub AI Writer proposes doc updates from pull requests. Missing for 10: detail on how far tasks can be delegated across many pages or run as multi-step autonomous work, and any independent or hands-on confirmation, since all evidence is vendor docs.
